name: Draw Things

knownPaths.description: Draw Things' sandbox container, which holds the model files it generates images with. In a typical installation the container holds nothing else: the folder inside it, Documents/Models, is where every downloaded model lives. Draw Things keeps these files even after the application is deleted, and the command-line version installed with Homebrew reads the same folder, so this is where the space goes if you stop using it. Removing it means downloading the models again.
Draw Things application data, for installations that keep their settings here rather than in the sandbox container.

description: Draw Things — image generation that runs entirely on the Mac.
